scope: Corrected replay launcher must reject failed/nonmatching/wrong-profile baselines before loading keys

result.scope:
Run the retained one-bit selector experiment after a matching baseline.

Waits for the original process to terminate and for its authoritative completion
report. Refuses a nonmatching baseline. Rechecks frozen executable/source,
retained state, corrected selector hash and available memory before launching.
No keys or inputs are generated. Diagnostic accuracy is separate from exit code.
result.error: baseline did not complete with identical saved ciphertext
